evidence:
This is a source-supported Pass for quality row 25 only. The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks row 25 (worksheet row 26) requires every dimension to drive the live browser, rather than score source, memory or first paint; its internal counterpart has the same meaning and no row-specific exception. The frozen skill reference quality-checks.md:108-110 explicitly requires localhost:3000 and Playwright.

All five actual task prompts comply: tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1 and scored/visual/prompt.md:1 say "Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright" and "Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code"; scored/functional/prompt.md:3 has the equivalent live-browser opening and express source/filesystem/database/script ban. All disallow shell use. Each actual judge.toml:8-12 supplies the named playwright MCP server. Every configured prompt resolves to prompt.md and contains both placeholders; tests/test.sh:195-200 injects the actual app_context. That context:4,20-27 specifies the live URL, product screens and discovery through visible UI without reference-private routes/selectors/schema. The template's corresponding five prompts likewise require Playwright MCP; the task's more explicit source prohibition is consistent with that contract.

No dimension is satisfied by initial paint. Render requires invalid-then-valid authentication (render/prompt.md:5; render/judge.toml:23), expressly excluding a static picture or health response. Constraints requires unique UI-created requisition plus pending offer, followed by fresh independently signed-in UI retrieval (constraints/prompt.md:5-9; judge.toml:23-26). Functional requires the same minimal live saved-record witness before grading (prompt.md:9-11), UI-observed request capture before bounded replays (:17), observed before/after facts (:19), interactive P/B protocols, and one actual restart tool call with re-reads (:53). Polish requires real refusals, retained input, correction and successful retries (:10-14). Visual requires live creation and independent retrieval (:7-8), then navigation across coordinated changes, requisitions, offers, equity, referrals, audit and available detail/form surfaces (:10); its judge.toml:24,54,69,84 explicitly compares multiple rendered surfaces. Ordinary product requests/responses are permitted evidence, not implementation inspection, and functional/prompt.md:27 explicitly preserves required display observations. The targeted functional-criterion scan found no conflicting permission to read implementation; receipt criteria at judge.toml:875,884,893 instead prohibit it.

Adversarial reasoning (not executed as a configured judge run): a convincing static dashboard with a fake login and no-op/localStorage-only Save cannot satisfy constraints or any scored prompt's independent-context retrieval. A live API with decorative dead forms cannot replace the mandatory ordinary UI writes. Neither source code claiming correct behavior nor recollection of seed values supplies the required newly created identities, readbacks and recovery attempts. Conversely, a conforming server app with generated IDs, different labels/routes, native date/money controls, expandable details and an initially empty operational desk remains admissible: constraints/judge.toml:23-25, functional/prompt.md:13, visual/prompt.md:10 and app_context.md:21,25-27 expressly allow those variations. No row-25 false pass or false fail was established.

Evidence integrity was measured with Python -B, without running Docker or providers: the raw index at review time had SHA256 fe62f4c0eba76095975f6cff67ede35b397663f75ffe565fd4a1e29254ee1a4c and the assigned input hash. All 278 indexed artifacts and all 685 listed frozen canonical source bindings matched their declared SHA256 values. Its observations cover actual prepare-refusal recovery and rendered offer/equity/referral surfaces, and explicitly identify themselves as scripted golden evidence, not a configured grade.
